name: Kel-Tec KSG-12 Shotgun
description_html:
The KSG-12 has come to tarkov

Description

KSG-12, a shotgun that can switch between left or right tube (dual tube system is not included with product). Boasting a large round capacity and it being a Kel-Tec product, Unique as one would say.

Available at Peacekeeper LL1 & 2 (Trade offers and Dollars)

Requested by RaiRaiTheRaichu

Install Instruction

1. Download the Zip from the Gdrive

2. Open the Zip

3. Copy the content of the Zip your SPT folder

4. Enjoy

Some “Known” issues

There is a bit of a quirk with Shotguns in general and that is no inventory reload. So if you are reloading on inventory and it goes to idle instead of going back to inventory, that is perfectly normal, default BSG Behaviour.

P.S Tarkov Shotguns are weird and probably broken in general
